headlines.title: ADP Acquires ZenBusiness
headlines.summary: ADP® (Nasdaq: ADP), a global leader in HR and payroll solutions, today announced that it has acquired ZenBusiness, a formation and compliance services business with an AI-powered platform that has helped over one million entrepreneurs begin their small business journey. With this acquisition, ADP can now support small businesses across all aspects of starting a business and scaling it, including business formation, insurance, payroll, compliance, HR and workforce management.

headlines.title: Automatic Data Processing (ADP) Lifts Annual Dividend To $7.60 Per Share
headlines.summary: Automatic Data Processing (NasdaqGS:ADP) announced a board-approved dividend increase alongside director elections at its recent annual meeting. The ADP board authorized a materially higher regular cash dividend, signaling a larger cash return commitment to shareholders. Shareholders also voted in new directors to the ADP board, reshaping oversight of management and long term priorities. The bigger dividend and new ADP board members tell only part of the story on this payroll giant.

description: Automatic Data Processing, Inc. provides cloud-based human capital management (HCM) solutions worldwide. It operates in two segments, Employer Services and Professional Employer Organization (PEO). The Employer Services segment offers strategic, cloud-based platforms, and human resources (HR) outsourcing solutions. This segment's offerings include RUN Powered by ADP, a software platform for small business payroll, HR, and compliance; ADP Workforce Now, a HCM solution used across mid-sized and large businesses to manage employees; and ADP Lyric HCM, a solution for HR management, payroll, workforce management, talent, and data analytics. Its PEO Services segment provides HR outsourcing solutions under ADP TotalSource name to businesses through a co-employment model. This segment also provides guidance, user-friendly technology, comprehensive employee benefits, and a risk management, safety, and workers' compensation program. The company was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Roseland, New Jersey.
